title: Massachusetts ban on local rent control (Ch. 40P)
requirement: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind, except a city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation subject to limits, and after six months compliance by property owners becomes entirely voluntary.
coverage_conditions: Applies to rent control regulation by cities and towns; such regulation may not cover evictions, occupancy, services, condominium conversion or removal of properties.

conditions.who: person or entity owning less than ten rental units

applicability.per_tenancy: Local rent control regulation may not apply to a rental unit that has a fair market rent exceeding $400.
coverage_quotes: nor may such regulation apply to any rental unit that is owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units or that has a fair market rent exceeding $400

exemptions: Cities or towns that accept this chapter may adopt rent control regulation; that regulation may not apply to units owned by a person owning fewer than ten rental units or units with fair market rent exceeding $400.
quoted_span: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind, except that any city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation that provides:
interaction: Bars cities and towns from enacting or maintaining rent control; only a municipality that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation.

relations.quote: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind
